superseded_evaluation: evaluation-v1 wrongly merged restarted native coordinate epochs because ID0 was reused; use evaluation-v2 only.
ground_truth_boundary: Python replay runner hashed all selected files including GT CSV bytes solely for provenance. It did not parse reference poses. Only independent evaluator parses GT; no ground-truth pose is supplied to native C++ inference.
frozen_result_wording_correction: The literal v1 result ate.reason says no ground truth is loaded by the replay process. Interpret this only as no reference pose inputs to inference; raw files were read for SHA verification. Current runner wording is corrected without native rerun.
adapter_change_after_run: Docstring and unmeasured-ATE wording only; no estimator, geometry, timing, metrics or data selection change.
tests: 10 passed in0.42seconds; fixed conversion, original integer clock, fisheye/IMU geometry, genuine causal IMU, GT quaternion/frame identity, reused-map epoch splitting.
independent_review: Direct independent SVD and brute-force nearest GT association reproduced paired ATE to1e-12m.
